datasets.name: obs_jobs
queryLines:
SELECT
  job_id,
  job_name,
  run_id,
  trigger_type,
  inicio_ts,
  fim_ts,
  duracao_segundos,
  ROUND(duracao_segundos / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_minutos,

  COALESCE(inicio_ts, created_at) DESC

datasets.name: orq_ultima_run
queryLines:
SELECT
  job_name AS Pipeline,
  DATE_FORMAT(fim_ts, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS `Concluído em`,
  CASE 
    WHEN duracao_segundos >= 60 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(duracao_segundos / 60), 'min ', ROUND(duracao_segundos % 60), 's')
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(duracao_segundos), ' seg')
  END AS `Tempo de Execução`,
  CASE
    WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅ Sucesso'
    WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄 Executando'
    WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN '❌ Falhou'
    ELSE status
  END AS Resultado
FROM
  observabilidade_jobs
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) DESC
LIMIT 1

datasets.name: orq_media_5runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_minutos
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs
WHERE
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: orq_taxa_sucesso
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    1
  ) AS taxa_sucesso_pct
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs
WHERE
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS

datasets.name: orq_task_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN task_key = 'check_landing_zone' THEN 'Verificação Landing Zone'
    WHEN task_key = 'bronze_bpa' THEN 'Bronze - BPA'
    WHEN task_key = 'bronze_bpp' THEN 'Bronze - BPP'
    WHEN task_key = 'bronze_dre' THEN 'Bronze - DRE'
    WHEN task_key = 'silver_bpa' THEN 'Silver - BPA'
    WHEN task_key = 'silver_bpp' THEN 'Silver - BPP'
    WHEN task_key = 'silver_dre' THEN 'Silver - DRE'
    WHEN task_key = 'verificacao_landing' THEN 'Verificação Diária'
    ELSE task_key
  END AS Etapa,
  ROUND(AVG(duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_minutos,
  'Pipeline Completo' AS barra
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes
WHERE
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
  AND task_key IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  task_key
ORDER BY
  duracao_minutos DESC

datasets.name: exe_total_registros
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(registros_processados), 0) AS total_registros
FROM
  observabilidade_execucoes
WHERE
  run_id
    = (
      SELECT
        j.run_id
      FROM
        observabilidade_jobs j
      WHERE
        j.run_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            run_id
          FROM
            observabilidade_execucoes
          WHERE
            run_id IS NOT NULL
        )
      ORDER BY
        COALESCE(j.fim_ts, j.created_at) DESC
      LIMIT 1

datasets.name: exe_cobertura
queryLines:
SELECT
  fonte,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2021
      THEN
        CASE status
          WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2021`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2022
      THEN
        CASE status
          WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2022`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2023
      THEN
        CASE status
          WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2023`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2024
      THEN
        CASE status
          WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2024`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2025
      THEN
        CASE status
          WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2025`,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN
        ano = 2026
      THEN
        CASE status
          WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '✅'
          WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '❌'
          WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '🔄'
          ELSE '—'
        END
    END
  ) AS `2026`
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      fonte,
      ano,
      status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fonte, ano ORDER BY fim_ts DESC) AS rn
    FROM
      workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes
    WHERE
      fonte IS NOT NULL
      AND ano IS NOT NULL
  ) sub
WHERE
  rn = 1
GROUP BY
  fonte
ORDER BY
  fonte

datasets.name: orq_status_hero

datasets.name: orq_execucoes_48h
queryLines:
SELECT
  job_name AS Pipeline,
  DATE_FORMAT(fim_ts, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS `Concluído em`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      duracao_segundos >= 60
    THEN
      CONCAT(FLOOR(duracao_segundos / 60), 'min ', ROUND(duracao_segundos % 60), 's')
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(duracao_segundos), ' seg')
  END AS `Tempo de Execução`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%[dev%'
      OR LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%dev]%'
    THEN
      'Dev'
    WHEN
      LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%[test%'
      OR LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%test]%'
    THEN
      'Test'
    WHEN
      LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%[prod%'
      OR LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%prod]%'
    THEN
      'Prod'
    ELSE 'N/D'
  END AS Ambiente,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) IN ('scheduled', 'periodic') THEN 'Automático'
    WHEN LOWER(trigger_type) = 'one_time' THEN 'Manual'
    ELSE trigger_type
  END AS `Tipo de Execução`,
  CASE
    WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'Sucesso'
    WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN 'Executando'
    WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 'Falhou'
    ELSE status
  END AS Resultado
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs
WHERE
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) DESC

      OR LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%test]%'
    THEN
      'Test'
    WHEN
      LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%[prod%'
      OR LOWER(job_name) LIKE '%prod]%'
    THEN
      'Prod'
    ELSE 'N/D'
  END AS Ambiente
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs
WHERE
  COALESCE(fim_ts, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
ORDER BY
  Ambiente

datasets.name: exe_heatmap_throughput
queryLines:
WITH ultima_run AS (
  SELECT
    e.run_id,
    MAX(j.fim_ts) AS max_fim_ts
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
      INNER JOIN workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs j
        ON e.run_id = j.run_id
  WHERE
    e.run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados > 0
    AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND e.duracao_segundos > 0
    AND j.fim_ts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    e.run_id
  ORDER BY
    max_fim_ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  e.fonte,
  e.etapa,
  ROUND(
    SUM(e.registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
    1
  ) AS throughput_reg_min,
  SUM(e.registros_processados) AS total_registros,
  ROUND(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS total_duracao_min
FROM
  workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
    INNER JOIN ultima_run r
      ON e.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE
  e.fonte IS NOT NULL
  AND e.etapa IN ('bronze', 'silver')
  AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
  AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  e.fonte,
  e.etapa
ORDER BY
  e.fonte,
  e.etapa

datasets.name: exe_kpis_contexto
queryLines:
WITH ultima_run AS (
  SELECT
    e.run_id,
    MAX(j.fim_ts) AS max_fim_ts
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
      INNER JOIN workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs j
        ON e.run_id = j.run_id
  WHERE
    e.run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados > 0
    AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND e.duracao_segundos > 0
    AND j.fim_ts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    e.run_id
  ORDER BY
    max_fim_ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
kpis_ultima AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(e.registros_processados) AS volume_total,
    ROUND(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_total_min,
    ROUND(
      SUM(e.registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
      0
    ) AS throughput_reg_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.id_execucao) AS total_execucoes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.registros_processados > 0 THEN e.id_execucao END) AS execucoes_completas
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
      INNER JOIN ultima_run r
        ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE
    e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
),
kpis_48h AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(volume_total) AS media_volume_48h,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_min) AS p10_duracao,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_min) AS p50_duracao,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duracao_total_min) AS p90_duracao,
    AVG(throughput_reg_min) AS media_throughput_48h
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        e.run_id,
        SUM(e.registros_processados) AS volume_total,
        ROUND(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_total_min,
        ROUND(
          SUM(e.registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
          0
        ) AS throughput_reg_min
      FROM
        workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
          INNER JOIN workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs j
            ON e.run_id = j.run_id
      WHERE
        j.fim_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
        AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
        AND e.registros_processados > 0
        AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
        AND e.duracao_segundos > 0
      GROUP BY
        e.run_id
    ) sub
)
SELECT
  k.volume_total,
  k.duracao_total_min,
  k.throughput_reg_min,
  k.total_execucoes,
  k.execucoes_completas,
  ROUND(
    ((k.volume_total - m.media_volume_48h) / NULLIF(m.media_volume_48h, 0)) * 100.0,
    0
  ) AS variacao_volume_pct,
  ROUND(m.media_volume_48h, 0) AS baseline_volume,
  ROUND(
    ((k.throughput_reg_min - m.media_throughput_48h) / NULLIF(m.media_throughput_48h, 0)) * 100.0,
    0
  ) AS variacao_throughput_pct,
  ROUND(m.media_throughput_48h, 0) AS baseline_throughput,
  100000 AS alvo_throughput,
  ROUND(m.p10_duracao, 1) AS p10_duracao,
  ROUND(m.p50_duracao, 1) AS p50_duracao,
  ROUND(m.p90_duracao, 1) AS p90_duracao
FROM
  kpis_ultima k
    CROSS JOIN kpis_48h m

datasets.name: exe_insights
queryLines:
WITH ultima_run AS (
  SELECT
    e.run_id,
    MAX(j.fim_ts) AS max_fim_ts
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
      INNER JOIN workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs j
        ON e.run_id = j.run_id
  WHERE
    e.run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados > 0
    AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND e.duracao_segundos > 0
    AND j.fim_ts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    e.run_id
  ORDER BY
    max_fim_ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
metricas_ultima AS (
  SELECT
    e.fonte,
    e.etapa,
    ROUND(
      SUM(e.registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
      0
    ) AS throughput_atual
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
      INNER JOIN ultima_run r
        ON e.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE
    e.fonte IS NOT NULL
    AND e.etapa IN ('bronze', 'silver')
    AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    e.fonte,
    e.etapa
),
baselines AS (
  SELECT
    fonte,
    etapa,
    ROUND(AVG(throughput_run), 0) AS throughput_baseline
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        e.fonte,
        e.etapa,
        e.run_id,
        ROUND(
          SUM(e.registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
          0
        ) AS throughput_run
      FROM
        workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
          INNER JOIN workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs j
            ON e.run_id = j.run_id
      WHERE
        j.fim_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
        AND e.fonte IS NOT NULL
        AND e.etapa IN ('bronze', 'silver')
        AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
        AND e.registros_processados > 0
        AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
        AND e.duracao_segundos > 0
      GROUP BY
        e.fonte,
        e.etapa,
        e.run_id
    ) sub
  GROUP BY
    fonte,
    etapa
),
analise AS (
  SELECT
    m.fonte,
    m.etapa,
    m.throughput_atual,
    b.throughput_baseline,
    ROUND(
      ((m.throughput_atual - b.throughput_baseline) / NULLIF(b.throughput_baseline, 0)) * 100.0,
      0
    ) AS variacao_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN m.throughput_atual < b.throughput_baseline * 0.7 THEN 'CRITICO'
      WHEN m.throughput_atual < b.throughput_baseline * 0.85 THEN 'ATENCAO'
      ELSE 'OK'
    END AS status
  FROM
    metricas_ultima m
      INNER JOIN baselines b
        ON m.fonte = b.fonte
        AND m.etapa = b.etapa
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(fonte, ' / ', etapa) AS fonte_etapa,
  throughput_atual,
  throughput_baseline,
  variacao_pct,
  status,
  CASE
    WHEN
      status = 'CRITICO'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'CRÍTICO: ',
        fonte,
        ' ',
        etapa,
        ' com throughput ',
        ABS(variacao_pct),
        '% abaixo da baseline — investigar urgente'
      )
    WHEN
      status = 'ATENCAO'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'ATENÇÃO: ',
        fonte,
        ' ',
        etapa,
        ' com throughput ',
        ABS(variacao_pct),
        '% abaixo da baseline — monitorar'
      )
    ELSE CONCAT(fonte, ' ', etapa, ' dentro do esperado (', variacao_pct, '% vs baseline)')
  END AS mensagem
FROM
  analise
ORDER BY
  CASE status
    WHEN 'CRITICO' THEN 1
    WHEN 'ATENCAO' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  variacao_pct

queryLines:
SELECT
  id_execucao,
  etapa,
  registros_processados,
  duracao_segundos,
  ROUND(duracao_segundos / 60.0, 2) AS duracao_minutos,
  ROUND(registros_processados / NULLIF(duracao_segundos / 60.0, 0), 1) AS throughput_reg_min,

  fonte,
  ano
FROM

datasets.name: exe_kpis_periodo
queryLines:
WITH run_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(j.fim_ts) AS run_period,
    SUM(e.registros_processados) AS volume_total,
    ROUND(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 1) AS duracao_total_min,
    ROUND(
      SUM(e.registros_processados) / NULLIF(SUM(e.duracao_segundos) / 60.0, 0),
      0
    ) AS throughput_reg_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.id_execucao) AS total_execucoes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN e.registros_processados > 0 THEN e.id_execucao
      END
    ) AS execucoes_completas
  FROM
    workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_execucoes e
      INNER JOIN workspace.proj_cvm_dev_05_apoio.observabilidade_jobs j
        ON e.run_id = j.run_id
  WHERE
    j.fim_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 48 HOURS
    AND e.run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados IS NOT NULL
    AND e.registros_processados > 0
    AND e.duracao_segundos IS NOT NULL
    AND e.duracao_segundos > 0
    AND j.fim_ts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    j.run_id
),
baselines AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(volume_total), 0) AS baseline_volume,
    ROUND(AVG(throughput_reg_min), 0) AS baseline_throughput,
    ROUND(AVG(duracao_total_min), 1) AS baseline_duracao,
    ROUND(AVG(execucoes_completas), 0) AS baseline_completude
  FROM
    run_metrics
)
SELECT
  r.run_period,
  r.volume_total,
  r.duracao_total_min,
  r.throughput_reg_min,
  r.total_execucoes,
  r.execucoes_completas,
  b.baseline_volume,
  b.baseline_throughput,
  b.baseline_duracao,
  b.baseline_completude
FROM
  run_metrics r CROSS JOIN baselines b
ORDER BY
  r.run_period ASC
